# Newton's third law

<!-- STEP id="equal" -->
Both balances show the same reading. Pull harder or more gently: the two readings change together and stay equal. The balances pull on each other with forces that are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction.

<!-- STEP id="law" -->
**Whenever one object exerts a force on a second object, the second object simultaneously exerts an equal and opposite force on the first object.**

This is Newton's third law of motion. The two forces always act on two different objects.
